title: He Left Me A Handover Note

scenes.text: I WORK ALONE. HE LEFT A NOTE.
scenes.narration: Somebody left a handover note on the security desk tonight. I have been the only one on nights for nine years.
scenes.imagePrompt: A single handwritten note lying squared up on an empty security desk under a lamp, a torch placed neatly beside it, no people, seen from a high corner security camera, wide-angle lens distortion, soft low-resolution video texture, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: It is a proper note. Cameras checked. Lift chained. One delivery for the office, not opened. The car wants fuel.
scenes.imagePrompt: Close view of a lined handover sheet with a column of ticked boxes, handwriting too small to read, a biro across it, no people, seen from a high corner security camera, wide-angle lens distortion, soft low-resolution video texture, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: Everything on it happened this week. It is signed off by the night officer.
scenes.imagePrompt: The bottom of a handwritten note with a looping signature in black ink, a dried tea ring beside it on the desk, no people, seen from a high corner security camera, wide-angle lens distortion, soft low-resolution video texture, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: At the bottom it says, handing over to you at two fourteen. Do not look at camera six until you have sat down.
